title: Stage Language Studies
description: Five independent studies of props, wardrobe boards, scenic details, and screen motifs that could extend a performance world.
creative_direction: Independent moodboard images should each isolate one part of a performance world: wardrobe rail, prop altar, screen texture, lighting sketch, or floor material board. They must feel presentation-ready for stage creative direction.
